rationale: Class (a). The two versions of .ai-sdlc/pr-lifecycle.yaml differ only in the header: main (1e2bb5ab9, AISDLC-879) deliberately omits apiVersion/kind/metadata and records why in the file comment; the 883 branch adds them. Every spec key (webhook, reconcile, stall, loopGuard, flipPreconditions) is already identical on main. Resolution: keep main's file verbatim (drop the branch's header), no spec change. Five-step: requirement questioned is the branch's header, deleted; nothing else to combine.
